items.name: ruskel-tokens
items.title: Ruskel tokens
items.author: Enric Trillo
items.description: The two-exposure token layer. Installs @ruskel/tokens and imports it, which also maps the system onto the shadcn variable contract.

items.name: ruskel-tailwind
items.title: Ruskel tokens (Tailwind v4)
items.author: Enric Trillo
items.description: The token layer plus the Tailwind v4 theme bridge. Adds utilities for the mark and tint rings, the neutral ramp, the density scale and the emission tokens, on top of the shadcn contract. Import after "tailwindcss".

items.name: ruskel
items.title: Ruskel
items.author: Enric Trillo
items.description: The whole system: tokens plus the component layer. 4px radius, no shadows, tighter density, mono tabular numerals, neutral focus. @ruskel/ui imports the tokens itself.
